items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
Through 7 games, the quartet of Jalen Johnson, Onyeka Okongwu, Jock Landale, and Lu Dort is 27-111 (24.3%) from three-point range.

Last season, those 4 players combined to shoot 36.1% over nearly 1,300 attempts.

Seems safe to project more shots will be falling in the future.

Atlanta outscored the Cavaliers 15-4 on fast break points.

items.title: Barring a late surprise that breaks after the 11:59 pm ET deadline, Onyeka Okongwu’s contract extension window is now closed for this cycle.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
Barring a late surprise that breaks after the 11:59 pm ET deadline, Onyeka Okongwu’s contract extension window is now closed for this cycle.

No big surprise, but worth noting.

Still 2 seasons remaining on his current deal with the Hawks.

quote.author: Brad Rowland
quote.text:
Starting tomorrow (Oct. 1), Onyeka Okongwu is eligible for a contract extension up to 3 years and $76.6 million total.

It's a short window, though.

Only eligible to extend until Oct. 19, then the door closes again.

(In contrast, Lu Dort is extension-eligible all season)
